Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add all POS app features: inventory, sales, auth, reports, CRM, analytics, cash drawer, sync, EIS

Complete offline-first POS system with BIR compliance including:
- Product & inventory management with variants, batches, suppliers, transfers
- Sales checkout with POS terminal, payments, discounts, voids, returns, hold/recall
- User management with roles, permissions, supervisor auth, shift management
- Reports: X/Z readings, daily sales, sales summary
- CRM & loyalty: customer CRUD, points earn/redeem/expire, membership tiers
- Advanced analytics: product, time, cashier, inventory analytics, custom reports
- Cash drawer: opening/closing counts, denomination entry, variance tracking
- Offline sync: queue, bulk sync, conflict resolution, OR allocation, health monitoring
- EIS integration: BIR submission, batch processing, error categorization
- Database layer with sql.js adapter, localStorage persistence, 15 migrations
- Electron + Capacitor platform adapters
- Specs and design docs for all 11 feature modules

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix dashboard scroll, period filter, and replace mock data with live queries

- Remove overflow:hidden from .layout-main and .dashboard-grid to fix scrolling
- Add getMetricsForPeriod\(\) to analyticsService for date-range-aware stats
- Fix changePeriod\(\) to reload metrics/trend/comparison together via Promise.all
- Rewrite SalesChart, PaymentChart, TopProducts, RecentOrders with live SQL queries
- All dashboard widgets now accept dateFrom/dateTo props and react to period changes
- Remove redundant RevenueChart from dashboard layout

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
